entities.summary: Zarina Hashmi, known professionally as Zarina, was an Indian American artist and printmaker based in New York City. Her work spans drawing, printmaking, and sculpture. Zarina was a painters & sculptors from Aligarh (1937-07-16, Aligarh–2020-04-25). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
